what_changed_and_what_did_not.amendment_classification: The dependency amendment is RUNTIME-AFFECTING but NOT EVALUATOR-LOGIC-AFFECTING. The research signal and evaluator code are preserved byte-identically; what changed is the executable environment required to make the evaluator runnable at all.
what_changed_and_what_did_not.governed_dependency_amendment: pandas 3.0.5, owner-adjudicated. Required because P10 binds pandas_version and no lock declared it; added rather than removed from the spec because dropping it would cut P10 from 17 bindings to 16, which D-S1 forbids.
